genre.name: Escape Room
genre.description: Crack clues to escape locked rooms

story.title: Whispers of the Interstitial
story.setting: Perched on the precipice of the Great Bifurcation, your phytolab hangs amidst a tangled web of iridescent data-spines and living conduits, stretching into an endless, pulsating void.
story.description: As Kith, a renowned xeno-botanist, you must navigate your crumbling phytolab, using a bespoke bio-acoustic interface to translate the panicked thoughts of the exotic flora around you. These vegetal whispers reveal not just the immediate structural dangers, but also fragmented, paradoxical truths about the Interstitial, a realm that exists *between* logic, where reality can be rewoven by aligning with its non-Euclidean frequencies.

genre.name: Platformer
genre.description: Jump, run, and collect through levels

story.title: The Spindlewood's Maw
story.setting: The Spindlewood is a sprawling, biomechanical horror where every gnarled, rust-eaten 'tree' is a towering automaton of bone and brass, its branches ending in whirring blades and dripping a viscous, oily ichor onto the fungal-choked ground.
story.description: As Rivet, an ex-acrobat now bound by grafts of living metal and grinding gears, you leap and grapple through the Spindlewood’s treacherous canopy, seeking the fabled Apex Cog that promises liberation from your encroaching assimilation. But every step towards freedom feels like a deeper embrace of the forest's hungry mechanics, and the whispered promise of 'rescue' carries the chilling dread that you might simply become a more intricate part of its horrific, eternal design.
